blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style monument consisting of a carved sandstone pedestal supporting a golden sun with sculpted facial features and pointed triangular rays. The front of the sun features serene closed or lowered eyes, a nose, and mouth, while the back is smooth and rounded. The square pillar pedestal has stepped molding and carved ornamental relief. The geometry is fully solid, smooth, and well-integrated with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A golden stylized sun with eight pointed triangular rays projecting outward around a rounded, upward-facing serene face, completely obscuring the pedestal beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 4.5 to 5 feet tall (reaching about shoulder-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide across the sun rays.
